title: Fear Wearing a Suit
headline: When Wisdom Is Really Fear of People
tagline: Many men call it wisdom. Sometimes it’s fear wearing a suit.
seo_title: When Wisdom Is Really Fear of Man: Men's Group Questions | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Many men call it wisdom. Sometimes it's fear wearing a suit. Discussion questions for men's groups on approval, fear of man and conviction.
verse_text: Choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve.

scriptures.text: Choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve.

blocks.text: Where am I shrinking back because I fear someone’s opinion?

items: Sometimes it’s fear wearing a suit.
Whose approval has had the greatest influence on your life?
How has fear of man shaped past decisions?
Where are you currently tempted to compromise conviction?
What is the difference between loving people and living for their approval?
What would change if God’s approval became enough?

blocks.text: Joshua stood before Israel and said:
